messages.message: Tangents are not used because the material has no normal texture.

views.front: The stowed rubber hose now forms a continuous rounded bend from the front guide to its retained end position, replacing the earlier sharp polygonal corners. The shell and hub covers remain intact.
views.rear: The fixing plate and rear case retain their shape with no visible protruding repair geometry. The rear connector is largely occluded here; its retained endpoints are covered by the measured geometry tests.
views.detail: The case, side cover and front guide remain closely fitted in the enlarged view. The visible hose entry is smooth and seated in the guide; the lower bend lies outside this crop.
views.underside: The low view clearly shows the stowed hose sweeping smoothly beneath the guide, without a pinched inner corner or detached endpoint. The nozzle holder and bottom casing remain separate.
views.clay: The neutral clay view confirms a rounded continuous hose silhouette and the retained casing, cover and mounting-plate construction, without the former hard angular bends.
